name: cell-ppt
description: Create editable native PowerPoint figures, with optional no-API maximum-fidelity local tracing.

interface.longDescription: Cell_ppt uses one reconstruction pipeline on Windows and macOS. Nature PPT adds local pixel-faithful tracing plus optional text-only cleanup and sharp editable text restoration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cell_ppt to reconstruct my uploaded scientific figure as editable native objects in the current PowerPoint slide.
